name: Remote Process Invocation: Request and Reply
use_when: Salesforce calls a remote system and waits for the result

name: Remote Process Invocation: Fire and Forget
use_when: Salesforce calls a remote system and does not wait for the result

name: Batch Data Synchronization
use_when: Data is copied between systems in bulk on a schedule

name: Remote Call-In
use_when: A remote system creates reads updates or deletes Salesforce data

name: UI Update Based on Data Changes
use_when: The Salesforce user interface updates when data changes without a page refresh

name: Data Virtualization
use_when: Salesforce shows data held in another system without copying it
